Today was my first speed workout of this training cycle. Twelve 400-yard intervals with 400 yards of recovery in between. It's always tough. Add to that that I was tired from a weekend of camping with Cub Scouts and working our church's social. I slept in a little bit later than normal, and hit the track around 8am.

Unfortunately we are in a heat wave, so by the time I got warmed up the temps were in the eighties. It's impossible to reach full speed when it gets that hot, and it takes much more energy to maintain speed. I gutted through all my intervals, most of them in the 6:10–6:15 range. But I cheated by walking on some of the the recovery intervals. I'm lucky that the track at Warinanco has a bathroom and water fountain close by, so I could drink and wet down my head and neck.

> But any work is good work. Tomorrow is a rest day.
